title: 异界大富翁
description:
Online system: players can have 2-4 friends online about bug
All bugs in the comment area have been repaired before may30,2020. If you have any new questions, please contact me immediately. gameplay 
Players can roll dice to randomly generate 1-6 points, and then move the corresponding steps. When they go to the open space, they can choose to buy real estate. When they go to the counting Road, they can add counting tickets. Buy land, collect tolls from others, use cards for them, and become a millionaire in the current world. stock market Real time stock market, players can buy stocks at any time
Special stocks will float up and down according to some events generated by players in the game, and shareholders will have authority in special buildings.
Let go, buy stocks, and crush competitors economically!
 gods Randomly refresh 11 gods in the map to make your life colorful. festivals There are specific events on specific festivals every year card With 52 different cards, please enjoy yourself.

weatherThe weather will be generated randomly every day, and the weather lasts for 5-8 days. There are 8 different kinds of weather, some of which will occur in specific months.

lotteryBuy lottery tickets in a specific grid and draw prizes every month. Maybe the prize is you!
magic houseUse magic to react wonderfully to all players on the field

description_short: This is a chess game for strategic players. Players can buy real estate by rolling dice, play small games or go to the counting road to get tickets, buy cards and become their own winning secret. Use tactics to defeat other players, and finally become a millionaire in the different world.
